label: TP
reason: The user-provided header value is decoded and passed into a HashMap, then retrieved via map8487.get("keyB-8487") and used directly in constructing the file path. This leads to path traversal because the input from request.getHeader('BenchmarkTest01036') becomes part of the filename through bar, which is then concatenated into fileName = Utils.TESTFILES_DIR + bar. Since the path is constructed dynamically from untrusted input and used to read a file, this constitutes a path traversal vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from header is decoded and passed to doSomething(), where it is stored in param and later used to construct a file path via bar and fileName
